preconditions.description: The number of servers is between 1 and 30,000.
Each server number in the rules is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: Each number from 1 to n appears exactly four times among a_i.
preconditions.description: Each server has exactly four processes to start with.

preconditions.expression: Each number from 1 to n appears eight times among b_i and c_i.
preconditions.description: Each server has a total of eight process placements due to replication.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating whether a valid order exists.
If 'YES' is output, the second line contains a permutation of the 4n rules.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> all(second_line[i] in range(1, 4*n+1) for i in range(4*n))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, the permutation contains all numbers from 1 to 4n exactly once.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> all(sum(second_line.count(x) for x in range(1, 4*n+1)) == 1 for i in range(4*n))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, each number from 1 to 4n appears exactly once in the permutation.
If 'YES' is output, the permutation represents a valid order of applying the rules.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= a_i, b_i, c_i <= n for a_i, b_i, c_i in rules)
invariants.description: Each rule specifies a valid server number.

invariants.expression: all(rules[i] != rules[j] for i in range(4*n) for j in range(i+1, 4*n))
all(rules[i][0] in range(1, n+1) for i in range(4*n))
invariants.description: Each rule specifies a valid server number.

invariants.expression: all(rules[i][1] in range(1, n+1) and rules[i][2] in range(1, n+1) for i in range(4*n))
invariants.description: Each rule specifies a valid server number for replication.

invariants.expression: all(rules[i][1] != rules[i][2] for i in range(4*n))
invariants.description: No rule replicates a process to the same server.

invariants.expression: all(rules[i][0] != rules[i][1] and rules[i][0] != rules[i][2] for i in range(4*n))
invariants.description: No rule replicates a process to the original server.

invariants.expression: all(rules[i][1] != rules[j][1] or rules[i][2] != rules[j][2] for i in range(4*n) for j in range(i+1, 4*n))
invariants.description: No two rules replicate to the same pair of servers.

invariants.expression: all(sum(1 for a_i in range(1, n+1) if a_i == rules[i][0]) == 4 for i in range(4*n))
invariants.description: Each original server has exactly four processes.

invariants.expression: all(sum(1 for a_i in range(1, n+1) if a_i == rules[i][1] or a_i == rules[i][2]) == 8 for i in range(4*n))
invariants.description: Each server has a total of eight process placements due to replication.
